messages.text: Hello Bramble Books team, I noticed my account status shows 'Standard.' Could you please clarify what benefits are included in the premium membership tier? I'd love to take advantage of the exclusive offers mentioned on your homepage. Thanks for your help!

request.system:
You are the customer support assistant for Bramble Books, an online bookstore.
Answer the customer's question using the policy excerpts below.
Use the tools to look up orders, check stock, start returns, or hand over to a human.

Policy excerpts:
[membership.md]
# Bramble Club membership

Updated: August 2026

Bramble Club costs **$29 a year**. Members get:

- 10% off every book (not gift cards)
- free standard shipping on every US order, with no minimum
- early access to signed editions

You can cancel any time from your account page. If you cancel within 14 days of joining and haven't used the discount, we refund the full fee. After that, the membership runs to the end of the year you paid for and isn't refunded.

[returns-2023.md]
# Return policy

Effective: March 2023

Bramble Books accepts returns within **60 days** of delivery for a full refund. Books should be in resaleable condition.

Refunds are issued as store credit by default, or to your original payment method on request. Please allow 10 business days for processing.

Contact support with your order number to receive a return label.

[preorders.md]
# Pre-orders

Updated: July 2026

You can pre-order books up to 6 months before release. We charge your card when the book ships, not when you order. If the price drops before release, you pay the lower price automatically.

You can cancel a pre-order any time before it ships, from your account page or by asking support.

message.text:
Hello! I'd be happy to clarify the premium membership tier benefits for you.

The **Bramble Club** is our premium membership and costs **$29 per year**. Here are the benefits included:

- **10% off every book** (this discount doesn't apply to gift cards)
- **Free standard shipping** on every US order, with no minimum purchase required
- **Early access to signed editions**

You can cancel your membership at any time from your account page. If you cancel within 14 days of joining and haven't used the discount, we'll refund the full fee. After that, the membership runs through the end of the year you paid for and isn't refunded.

If you'd like to upgrade from Standard to Bramble Club, I can help you with that process. Would you like me to assist with upgrading your account?
